g.text: Tonal, envelope, and stereo diagnostics · 48 kHz stereo

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #404040

g.text: Original deterministic synthetic sources; piano-like is synthesis, not an acoustic recording.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #404040

g.text: Identical delay-aligned inputs. RMS matching is not LUFS matching. Numerical difference is not a quality score.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #404040

g.text: Envelope ratios include level change. Crest factor is level invariant. Whole-source correlation does not fully describe stereo imaging.
